main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean next-day return minus coin's mean daily return (bars with forecast > 0)

statistic.name: t of the forecast-weighted mean, cases of one day summed

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive; fewer than 100 distinct days -> not observable

decided_by: the t lies between -2 and 2 (inconclusive rule).
reading: every bar with forecast > 0 and a next close in the same window is a case, the coin's mean is the mean of all its in-window 1-bar returns, the t is the weighted mean over a standard error built from the forecast-weighted deviations summed per UTC day, and days are counted over these usable cases.
